units.translation: What then, Lord Darius, to what end do you turn?
What then do you bid me?
What other thing then did he devise for the ill-fated cow?

The flight of birds he accurately distinguished—and the way of life each has, and what enmities and affections and gatherings they have toward one another; and the smoothness of entrails and what color they would have to be pleasing to the gods.
Show me a sign of what awaits me to suffer, what remedy, or what medicine for the disease.
Show me the end of my wandering, what time there will be for the wretched woman.
So that he may learn what he must do or say to act in a way dear to the gods.
Nor do I know what I might become.
Know whom you think you are sending.
Perhaps someone might say, who are they?
Nor do I know what to say.
Before someone seizes the hard-to-capture beginning.
If someone softens the heart at the right time.
If someone falls into illness.
Where someone is about to bring tears.
Even if no one hears of my rule.
And no one has ever seen Zeus defeated by anyone (thus rightly Elmsley for που).
If someone bears misfortune without shame.
Perhaps someone might say.
Unless someone else wishes to bury this man with him.
But someone formerly believing in the gods nowhere.
When someone himself is eager.
Let no one pour out great wealth.
And someone, gladly shouting victory songs to Zeus, will attain complete wisdom.
Someone said that the gods do not deem it worthy to care for mortals.
When someone thinking good things sees.
For those whom someone sent, he knows.
Someone mutters these things.
One might say that these things are easy to have.
And if someone speaks of a bird-killing storm.
And someone rebuking me said.
Either someone stole it or some god led the way.
Lest someone, whom we do not see?
If anyone, knowing well, I have spoken this end.
Someone repeated in the same sentence Eum. 545 would loosen against the sandals.
One might befit a shadow.
For how would someone preparing hostile things against enemies fence them off?
If someone deems it worthy to learn.
As someone sending away purifications.
So that no one will learn.
Where might one turn?
For someone pouring out everything.
And someone likened the terrible thing to the Lemnian woes.
May someone give a man-slaying axe.
What of these things would one say is justly held?
Nor is there any fellow-banqueter sharing in common.
If someone speaks a clear word.
And some wretched person consoles in vain.
Let no one call upon.
In view of these things, let someone honor the reverence of parents and, respecting the guest-honoring visits to the house, let him be.
And someone will know the words in length.
Someone will think he hears.
If there is any guardian.
And indeed someone killed a friend.
Let no one be idle.
Unless someone goes to the ship.
If someone does not take these things.
Neither does someone die having received many wounds in the chest, nor does someone sitting in the house by the hearth flee.
By fear of someone.
By force of someone.
By other constraints (thus Bothius for 'of another necessity'), or fearing someone's anger?
Let it not seem to anyone.
Nor let it seem to anyone again.
Must one expect that someone will rule over Zeus?
To inquire further about someone.
So that someone passing by the houses might conjecture.
And hastening to relieve someone (Pauwius: Zeus) of these cares.
And how? When the rulers were absent, did you fear some people?
